name: The Straits Trading Company Limited
summary: The Straits Trading Company Limited, a conglomerate-investment company, engages in the resources, property, and hospitality businesses. The company operates in four segments: Resources, Real Estate, Hospitality, and Others. It engages in the smelting of tin concentrates and tin bearing materials. The company produces and sells various grades of refined tin metal and by-products; and invests in other metals and mineral resources. In addition, it invests in, develops, leases, and sells real estate properties; provides property and real estate fund management services; and owns and manages hotels.
